| **AWS (Cloud)** | 20% | Enterprise cloud demand, AI workloads |
| **E-Commerce Marketplace** | 35% | Prime membership, international expansion |
| **Advertising** | 10% | Digital ad inventory across sites |
| **Physical Stores & Logistics** | 15% | Whole Foods, Amazon Fresh, delivery network |

| Ratio | Current | Trend | Interpretation |
|------|----------|-------|---------------|
